nodes.title: Note: Padding / Cropping the Video
widgets_values: Unfortunately the YOLO algorithm requires image dimensions to be multiples of 32. So here we pad the video height (from 720 to 736), and then we crop it later.

nodes.title: Note: Loading the Model
widgets_values: Here we load the Ultralytics YOLO model we trained! We uploaded it to our assets in `ComfyUI/models/ultralytics/bbox/`.
